title: The SSH host's JSON output was only checked to be an array, so a task without its fields was accepted and crashed the view
resolution: isTaskProgress validates every field and the stage range; an invalid remote answer becomes an error of that host only; test 'an SSH host with the script returns its tasks; failures are reported'

title: After the remote root was found, SSH transport failures in the fallback reader became missing data, so a dropped connection showed a host without tasks or a wrong stage
resolution: The SSH reader throws TransportError on exit 255, verifiedAt rethrows it, and readSshHost reports the host unreachable; test 'an SSH host that stops answering during the fallback is unreachable'

title: The first active change won over the branch's own archived change, so a worktree showed another task and lost its archived or landed stage
resolution: An exact active match, then the branch's archived change, wins; another change only when it is the worktree's one change; tests 'the archived change of the branch wins over another active change' and 'a worktree with several changes, none of them the branch, is skipped'

title: The lock was stolen by age alone and removed unconditionally, so a slow refresh lost its lock and later removed another refresh's lock
resolution: scripts/task-progress-lock.ts: a hard-linked lock with pid and token, taken over only from a dead process or, without a readable owner, after 300 s, moved aside and checked before removal, released only by its owner; tests in test/task-progress-lock.test.ts with eight concurrent processes

title: A cache with only generatedAtEpoch counted as fresh, and a future timestamp blocked refreshes
resolution: readCache validates the report's shape; cacheAgeSeconds treats an invalid cache or one more than 60 s ahead as due; the status line does the same; test 'an invalid or future cache is due for a refresh'

title: A null pass line crashed the collection and {} counted as a Low-only pass
resolution: parsePasses accepts only records with four non-negative integer counts and reports other lines as task problems shown on the row; test 'corrupt pass records are reported, not counted, and never crash'

title: The spec delta did not require one row per task, the non-blocking background refresh, or the missing, stale, and corrupt cache behavior
resolution: Added the requirements 'Stacked task progress rows' and 'Progress cache refresh' with scenarios

title: The rendered time was asserted to end in :00 in the host's time zone, which fails in half-hour zones
resolution: The test file pins TZ to UTC and asserts the exact time 10-28 09:00
